subject.title: Support Workers AI model selection during onboard

question: Should Cloudflare Workers AI support be added to the bundled Cloudflare AI Gateway provider onboarding flow, or should OpenClaw document the generic custom-provider path as the supported Workers AI setup?
rationale: Current code can support manual OpenAI-compatible provider config, but changing the provider plugin auth-choice/onboard behavior would add provider-facing setup and model-selection surface that maintainers have already labeled as needing product direction.

options.title: Add provider-owned Workers AI mode
options.body: Extend the Cloudflare AI Gateway plugin to write the Workers AI base URL, OpenAI-compatible API adapter, model list, and default model during onboarding.

options.title: Document custom-provider setup
options.body: Keep the bundled Cloudflare AI Gateway provider Anthropic-only and publish a precise Workers AI custom-provider onboarding command and config example.

options.title: Fold into broader AIG bridge
options.body: Track this only through the broader Cloudflare AI Gateway bridge design so onboarding lands together with REST/model-catalog semantics.

recommendation.title: Add provider-owned Workers AI mode
recommendation.body: Extend the Cloudflare AI Gateway plugin to write the Workers AI base URL, OpenAI-compatible API adapter, model list, and default model during onboarding.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent docs/provider work put this person closest to the checked-in Cloudflare onboarding surface.
